<!-- 2026-09-16T05:49Z https://github.com/kamilsk/dotfiles/issues/255#issuecomment-5711693105
Code vs intent (zsh only): the `has` branch of `path()` in `bin/lib/env.bash` loops `for path in "${@}"`. In zsh `path` is the array tied to `PATH`, so `path has foo` sets `PATH=foo` for the rest of the session. Rename the loop variable. `.github/reviews/20260709T130934Z.md` finding 6.
